lessonTitleEnglish: Fractions in the ancient world — Practice
source: По темам армянских учебников математики для 5 класса

stages.headline: Запиши /K \frac{5}{6} K/ в виде суммы двух разных дробей с числителем 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: Write 5/6 as a sum of two different fractions with numerator 1.
stages.problemText: Write 5/6 as a sum of two different fractions with numerator 1.
stages.customInstructions: Accept any correct pair of distinct unit fractions.

stages.headline: Сколько секунд составляет /K \frac{3}{4} K/ минуты?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many seconds are 3/4 of a minute?
stages.problemText: How many seconds are 3/4 of a minute?

stages.headline: Треть и шестая часть числа вместе равны 12. Найди число.
stages.headlineEnglish: A third and a sixth of a number together make 12. Find the number.
stages.problemText: A third and a sixth of a number together make 12. Find the number.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. 1/3 + 1/6 = 2/6 + 1/6 = 1/2. 2. Половина числа равна 12, значит, число равно 24.

stages.headline: Путешественник прошел половину пути, затем половину оставшегося, и ему осталось 5 км. Какова была длина всего пути?
stages.headlineEnglish: A traveller covered half the road, then half of the rest, and 5 km remained. How long was the road?
stages.problemText: A traveller covered half the road, then half of the rest, and 5 km remained. How long was the road?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. После половины осталось 1/2, затем половина от 1/2 — это 1/4. 2. 1/4 составляет 5 км, значит, весь путь — 20 км.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. After two halvings 1/4 remains. 2. 1/4 is 5 km, so 20 km.

stages.headline: Запиши /K \frac{7}{12} K/ в виде суммы двух разных дробей с числителем 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: Write 7/12 as a sum of two different fractions with numerator 1.
stages.problemText: Write 7/12 as a sum of two different fractions with numerator 1.
stages.customInstructions: Accept any correct pair of distinct unit fractions.
